Our Story

Made by hand,
with intention.

Handmade · Small-batch · Jefferson County, Idaho

The Artisanal Heart

Ever since I can remember, I have always wanted to be some grand heroine and save the world — only to realize that my greatest impact lay in the craft I loved most.

Everything Fudge is the intersection of high-end artistry and a heart for service. Inspired by the precision of Swiss-German confectionery, every batch is a small-batch ritual — hand-stirred, hand-beaten, and hand-portioned right here in Rigby, Idaho.

How It Began

It did not start with a business plan. It started with a copper pot, a block of Callebaut couverture chocolate, and a deep belief that the finest things in life should be made slowly, with intention, and shared generously.

I taught myself the craft the old way — studying European confectionery technique, sourcing only the ingredients that professional chocolatiers trust: Dutch Swiss butter, high-fat cream, Dutch processed cocoa, and Belgian Callebaut couverture. No shortcuts. No substitutes.

What began as a labor of love in a village kitchen became something I could not keep to myself.

Fudge with a Purpose

As the batches grew, so did a question: what if this craft could do more than delight?

In the tradition of European excellence, we believe that true luxury is found in community. That is why 100% of our profits are donated directly to local food pantries in the Rigby and Idaho Falls areas — including our proud partner, The Giving Cupboard.

When you gift Everything Fudge, you are not just rewarding your team or treating someone you love. You are providing a meal for a neighbor in need.

What We Believe

Real butter. Real cream. Real impact.

We reject industrial shortcuts in favor of a five-step Small-Batch Ritual:

1. Sourcing of Origins — Only the finest ingredients make it into our kitchen.
2. The Melt — Slow-infused to a precise temperature, never rushed.
3. Deliberate Cool — A patient cooling that builds the foundation of perfect texture.
4. The Hand-Beating — Beaten by hand to create a micro-crystalline, velvet texture that melts at body temperature.
5. Hand-Portioned — Each piece cut by hand for an authentic, rustic finish.

“You do not have to change the whole world to make it a little sweeter.”

Every purchase is a ripple effect of kindness. Every bite, a testament to what happens when craft meets conscience.

Thank you for being part of something sweeter.

— The Everything Fudge Family
